purpose.zh: 练大腿、臀部和大腿内侧，提升侧向移动能力
purpose.en: Build the thighs, glutes, and inner thighs for side-to-side movement.

text.zh: 向侧面跨一步，臀部向后坐到跨出腿
text.en: Step out to the side and sit your hips back over that leg

text.zh: 另一条腿伸直，双脚脚尖朝前
text.en: Keep the other leg straight and both feet facing forward.

text.zh: 用跨出脚推地回到站立
text.en: Push off the stepping foot to return to standing.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the heel of the stepping foot.

cautions.zh: 膝盖不适时减小下蹲深度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Squat less deep if your knees feel uncomfortable, and stop if the pain continues.
